LanguageData.VFEC_CenturionArmor.description: The prescence of centurion armor encourages nearby allied fighters to fight through pain.
LanguageData.VFEC_CenturionArmor.label: centurion armor
LanguageData.VFEC_CenturionArmorBuff.description: The ability to withstand pain is increased thanks to being near someone wearing centurion armor.
LanguageData.VFEC_CenturionArmorBuff.label: centurion armor buff
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumAddiction.description: A chemical addiction to opium. Long-term presence of opium has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of opium, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumAddiction.label: opium addiction
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumAddiction.stages.1.label: withdrawal
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumHigh.description: Active opium in the bloodstream. Dulls out pain completely.
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumHigh.label: high on opium
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to opium. The more severe this tolerance is, the more opium it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.VFEC_OpiumTolerance.label: opium tolerance
